# CalcSouq

> Free online calculators and tools. Every tool runs in the browser, shows its formula and needs no sign-up. Available in English, Hindi (hi), Chinese (zh), Russian (ru) and Malayalam (ml).

## English
- [UAE Final Settlement Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/uae-final-settlement-calculator/): Gratuity, leave, notice and salary in one statement
- [Savings Goal Planner (Abroad to Home)](https://www.calcsouq.com/gulf-savings-return-planner/): How long until you reach your savings target, with growth and currency
- [UAE Gratuity Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/uae-gratuity-calculator/): End-of-service benefit under the new labour law
- [UAE VAT Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/uae-vat-calculator/): Add or remove 5% VAT in AED
- [Gold Jewellery Price Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/gold-price-calculator/): Rate × weight + making charge + VAT or GST
- [AED to INR Remittance Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/aed-to-inr-calculator/): Compare exchange houses by rupees received
- [Pip Value Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/forex-pip-value-calculator/): Value of one pip per lot in your currency
- [Position Size Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/position-size-calculator/): Lot size from account risk and stop loss
- [Forex Margin Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/forex-margin-calculator/): Required margin for any lot size and leverage
- [Forex Swap Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/swap-calculator/): Overnight rollover with triple-swap days
- [Futures Tick Value Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/futures-tick-value-calculator/): Tick value and P&L for CME contracts
- [World Market Hours](https://www.calcsouq.com/market-hours/): Which markets are open right now
- [Kerala Land Area Converter](https://www.calcsouq.com/kerala-land-converter/): Cent, acre, are, sq ft and more
- [Kerala Stamp Duty Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/kerala-stamp-duty-calculator/): 8% stamp duty + 2% registration fee
- [UAE Leave Encashment Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/uae-leave-encashment-calculator/): Pay for unused annual leave, on basic salary
- [Gold Tola & Pavan Converter](https://www.calcsouq.com/gold-tola-pavan-converter/): Tola, pavan, grams and troy ounces
- [Loan EMI Calculator (AED & ₹)](https://www.calcsouq.com/loan-emi-calculator/): Monthly instalment and total interest

- [Trading Strategy Simulator](https://www.calcsouq.com/trading-strategy-simulator/): 1,000 simulated runs: drawdown and risk of ruin
- [Photo Resizer for Applications](https://www.calcsouq.com/photo-resizer/): Crop, resize, compress to KB, add name & date
- [Kerala PSC Photo Resizer (150×200, 30 KB, Name & Date)](https://www.calcsouq.com/kerala-psc-photo-resizer/): 150 × 200 px, under 30 KB, name and date added
- [Resize Photo to 20 KB](https://www.calcsouq.com/resize-photo-to-20kb/): Compress any photo to under 20 KB
- [Resize Photo to 50 KB](https://www.calcsouq.com/resize-photo-to-50kb/): Photo between 20 and 50 KB, passport size
- [Signature Resizer (10–20 KB)](https://www.calcsouq.com/signature-resizer/): Signature to 140 × 60 px, 10–20 KB
- [Passport Size Photo Maker (3.5 × 4.5 cm)](https://www.calcsouq.com/passport-size-photo-maker/): 3.5 × 4.5 cm photo from your phone
- [US Visa Photo Resizer (600×600, DS-160)](https://www.calcsouq.com/us-visa-photo-resizer/): DS-160 photo: 600 × 600 px, under 240 KB
- [UAE Visa Photo Resizer (43 × 55 mm)](https://www.calcsouq.com/uae-visa-photo-resizer/): 43 × 55 mm, white background
- [Image to PDF (JPG to PDF)](https://www.calcsouq.com/image-to-pdf/): Combine photos into one PDF, private
- [Age Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/age-calculator/): Exact age on any date, next birthday
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/percentage-calculator/): % of, % change, increase and decrease
- [SIP Calculator (with Step-Up)](https://www.calcsouq.com/sip-calculator/): Monthly investing with yearly step-up
- [Compound Interest & FD Calculator](https://www.calcsouq.com/compound-interest-calculator/): FD maturity and compound growth
- [GST Calculator (India, 2026 Rates)](https://www.calcsouq.com/gst-calculator/): Add or remove GST, CGST/SGST split
